bar.text: ...SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH LATE TONIGHT... Combined seas 20 to 22 ft with breakers this morning. Seas ease to 14 to 16 ft this evening. Bar conditions severe. Maximum ebb currents will occur around 345 PM Sunday, 400 AM Monday, and 415 PM Monday. The afternoon ebbs on Sunday and Monday will be strong.
